decision_summary: Self-review approves v0.6.34 within its evidence-only non-optimization boundary.
rationale: Visionary: users can see exactly where an action flips. Builder: alternatives straddle baseline and the cartesian replay, classes, weights, errors, distances, flips, and signals reproduce. Guardian: identical evidence and one policy are retained; sensitivity never ranks or selects policy; insufficient and brittle results route to governance.
recommendation: Release and carry multi-route escalation into v0.6.35.
